messages.subject: Indigo — Companies House filings
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya — we're filing the SH01 for the 1,500,000 Series B shares and the amended & restated Articles today, within the 15-day window. I'll send the filing receipts for the company's statutory books. The completion checklist is fully ticked save for this item, which I'll close out on filing.

Elena
